QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`. `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (line 2185) are also off.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the shipped config leaves THREADING_C off (commented out) and also PTHREAD and ALT off, so a default build defines none of them, including both threading macros.
